chunks.subject: AP Research
chunks.title: Academic Paper exemplar — Sample D, 4/5
chunks.content: Sample D scored 4/5 (Well-Supported, Articulate Argument Conveying a New Understanding). Topic: the extrinsic and intrinsic factors that motivate people to take action, with a clear research question. The method aligns to the inquiry and the argument for a new understanding is well supported, but it remains a 4 rather than a 5 because the analysis does not reach the depth or gap-addressing richness of the top band. Illustrates a solid, articulate paper short of the richest analysis.
